caption: The drawing features a cast iron lacework bracket illustrated from two perspectives: one integrated into the corner of a building beneath a roof, and one shown in isolation with dimensions. The bracket is highly ornate, with intricate swirling patterns and flourishes reminiscent of lace or filigree. The additional view presents the bracket as a right-angled triangle, with two fixed dimensions labeled as 40 inches for the horizontal edge and 45 inches for the vertical edge, and the hypotenuse measuring 60 3/4 inches. The background of the drawing is a light tan, and all lines and details are rendered in black ink. The surrounding architecture includes rectangular stone or brickwork, a section of a roof, and a shuttered window below the bracket. A labeled box in the lower right corner contains the text "CAST IRON LACEWORK BRACKET." The entire composition is framed by a simple single-line rectangular border, with decorative corner accents.
title: Iron Work on Balcony
